name: heymate
description: The AI buddy that lives in your Mac's notch. Push-to-talk, sees your screen, answers out loud, and runs Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode agents on the subscription you already have. Free, open source, native SwiftUI.

paragraphs: Ask how to do something in a desktop app or website. HeyMate points to the next step, explains it out loud, and waits while you try it. Currently available for macOS.

The open-source alternative to HeyClicky. Bring your own AI: your existing Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), or OpenCode subscription does the work. HeyMate is free and MIT licensed; we do not meter your model use. Provider limits and optional paid connectors still apply.
Hold ⌃ ⌥, ask about anything on screen, let go. Illustrated example: ask "why is my Mac so slow?" and get a spoken answer with a pointer.
features: Help with desktop apps and websites. Spoken explanations and a cursor that points at the control being discussed. Screen context is captured during active interactions that need it, including each step of a walkthrough.
